name: oh-my-claudecode
tagline: Claude Code plugin adding multi-agent teams, skills and workflow pipelines.
description: Extends Claude Code with a set of specialised agents, skills and workflow commands, including a Team runtime that spawns workers in tmux panes and an autonomous loop mode. It installs as an npm CLI or a Claude Code plugin and can involve other installed CLIs such as Codex and Gemini in its workflows.

pricing.notes: Open source under MIT; Claude access comes from your own subscription or API key.
